note: The match length comes from input-controlled compressed-data structure and determines how many extension bytes will be emitted.
The limited-output safety check underestimates the bytes needed for long match-length encodings because it only budgets matchCode>>8 extension bytes instead of the actual 255-byte run structure.
Execution continues into the long-match encoding path after the insufficient bound check passes.
The encoder writes extension words past the end of the output buffer, triggering the heap-buffer-overflow.
